answer: The design leans on commit-reveal work receipts, diluted when peers disagree. Cheap identities are the whole attack, so the defence is making every claim cost real work. Written in a numbers heavy, no adjectives register, it stays short. What survives to the sable is a record of labour, not a list of addresses. Each submission hangs on the kernel of a task receipt, and the crystal is checked by a panel whose members never see the submitter.
